info.title: Miqaat Core Identity Authorization Service
info.description: Dynamic Business Unit / Utility / Application / Environment / Module / Role / Permission model, client registry and server-side authorization checks. No API keys: every call carries an RS256 bearer JWT verified via JWKS - service tokens (typ client-authentication+jwt) from registered service principals, or administrator access tokens (typ at+jwt) issued by Identity Federation. Never stores credentials.

tenant_id.description: Only for ADMIN service principals; users always create in their own tenant

application_code.description: Owning application; omit for a Core Portal module

its_id.description: ITS ID is the user ID

scope_id.description: NULL for CORE, else bu_id or utility_id

client_id.description: Globally unique; never reused across environments

initiate_login_uri.description: Used by the Core Portal launcher

reason.description: Reason recorded in client status history

back_channel_logout_uri.description: null removes the back-channel logout URI
